items.author: Lennart Ronge

items.difficulty_reason: The proof goes beyond a small operator-norm perturbation argument: it works modulo compact operators on a finite-codimension subspace and constructs a projection homotopy that controls the Calkin distance while reducing index additivity to compact differences. These are the substantive operator-theoretic steps behind the sharp APS stability applications.
